evidence.label: Pipeline fee
evidence.value: 0.25% of each swap's input, charged by the router on every hop and paid to Pipeline's treasury.
evidence.source: Pipeline docs/INTEGRATOR-GUIDE.md; constant text kept by Aviary

evidence.label: Router protections on swaps
evidence.value: The router moves your input into the strategy's vault, refuses the swap if you would receive less than your minimum, and never takes more than the amount you signed. You do not sign the call to the strategy, so it can pay you but cannot take from your accounts.

evidence.label: Custom actions
evidence.value: Any strategy instruction other than a swap is signed directly on the strategy; the router's protections and fee do not apply to it.

evidence.label: Bypass
evidence.value: A strategy may allow trades that skip the router; those pay no Pipeline fee and leave no swap event.

evidence.label: Vetting
evidence.value: Pipeline does not vet strategies; anyone can register one.

evidence.label: Router control on devnet
evidence.value: The router is upgradeable. Its upgrade authority 2yJJsmhvs2SBsKVtiKCG4wBJNoTH67aRNMhSwkupvUHZ is also its admin, who can pause swaps, market creation and registration.
evidence.source: Router ProgramData 3dpKiLED... and Config BmdeX3kW... read 2026-11-09 at slot 520324283

summary.text: This strategy appears to run token launches: each market mints a token, sells it from a curve for SOL, then moves the liquidity to another strategy.
In the sampled market the creator received 1.0% of the SOL traded and 5% of the token supply, and the curve no longer trades.
The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace the code at any time, and with no verified source the price rule is unknown.

claims.text: Each market appears to create its own token: the sampled one was minted in the market's first transaction, 1,000,000,000 of it, into the curve's vault.
Of its 12 markets, 9 have graduated and refuse new trades, and the other 3 have never traded.
At graduation, 5.0456 SOL and 211,111,111.111112 tokens moved into a new market on strategy 4ajW...uwJD, and the wallet that triggered it was paid 0.01 SOL.
Every wallet that traded in the sampled market was first funded by 2yJJ...vUHZ, in one transaction at 11:30 UTC on 2026-11-08.
The key 2yJJ...vUHZ can replace the program's code at any time, for every market; it did so twice on 2026-11-08.
The same key is the router's upgrade authority and admin, who can pause swaps.
The sampled token has no mint or freeze authority, so nobody can mint more of it or freeze your tokens.
An instruction named set_fee_recipient appears to let someone redirect the creator fee; it has never been called.
On 2026-11-09, an open curve quoted 101,807,639.836289 tokens for 0.01 SOL, and refused a sale quote because it held no SOL yet.
A call to the strategy's swap that skipped the router was refused.
Trades through Pipeline get the router's minimum-output check and pay its 0.25% fee.
Claiming fees, claiming the allocation and graduating are signed directly on the strategy, outside the router's protections.
Its author has published no description: the metadata link returns an error.

unknowns.text: With no public or verified source, the price curve, the graduation rule and who may call each custom action are unknown.
Whether a sale works at larger sizes or after time passes: the full exit test has not run.
